Description
Clark University was founded in 1887 as the first all-graduate institution in the country. At Clark, students study the world while being immersed in it. Students wrestle with complex ideas, and consider new and unfamiliar perspectives. A graduate degree from Clark University’s School of Management, Department of International Development, Community, and Environment, Becker School of Design and Technology, or the School of Professional Studies delivers intellectual growth, enhanced career satisfaction, and a lifetime of increased earnings and fulfilling employment opportunities.
